hypothesis: W-R11's positional model may exploit identical-pair positives. Test whether 16-feature trainable temporal discrimination generalizes after global input-channel offset nuisance on positive and reordered negative pairs. Anchor-relative circular features should retain temporal order while removing nuisance.
source: Exact W-R11 deterministic 16-tick four-channel generator; nine entities per seed; no data-tuned generator.
arms: unordered_relative_histogram: 16-bin first-channel modulo-16 histogram of relative-to-first circular offsets
anchor_relative_circular_position: 16 circular first-channel differences after subtracting each sequence's own first channel modulo 256
pair_generation: Take original W-R11 16x4 tuple. Apply +17 modulo 256 to all channels/ticks for training second sequence and +31 for heldout second sequence. Positive preserves shifted sequence order. Negative changes only the shifted tail: reverse 15 tail ticks in development and rotate tail left by 5 in heldout. Positive/negative candidates have exactly same first observation and multiset for matched seed and entity.
learning: Same 16 weights+bias perceptron initialized to zero, 32 ordered epochs, learning rate 0.1, label +1/-1, update iff signed margin <=0; no heldout updates.
primary: Per-arm heldout balanced accuracy over 4 seeds x 9 entities x positive/negative. NUISANCE_INVARIANT_TRANSFER only if anchor-relative >=0.85 and unordered <=0.55; otherwise PARTIAL if anchor-relative exceeds both comparators, else NEGATIVE. Retain per-seed confusion and all negative findings.
independent_checks: 16-feature width and equal training examples/epochs across arms
same first row and multiset for both labels per example
positive shifted pair is not byte-identical to original
anchor-relative invariant to global shift on identical order
determinism twice; first-use archive; exact Git blob identities; one full regression
claim_limit: Small supervised synthetic invariant representation evaluation; not natural language, language prediction or autonomous intelligence; no accepted-ref mutation.
